title: Cryptography by Hand
summary: Break and build toy ciphers, hashes and random number generators in C, cryptopals style, to see exactly why real systems do what they do.
description: Encode bytes, experiment with repeating XOR and Caesar ciphers, predict a toy LCG, identify repeated blocks, explore a tiny hash collision and combine byte comparison with hex decoding. These deliberately weak constructions explain failure modes; they are not cryptographic tools. Use vetted cryptographic libraries and operating-system randomness in real applications.
